responsibility: Implements MSP430 device-data discovery and lookup shared by the driver and backend. It owns the extracted_mcu_data global, path-handling helpers such as msp430_dirname, logic for locating support files and devices.csv from environment variables or installed toolchain paths, parsing and validation of MCU names and their attributes, and a large built-in MCU table mapping device names to ISA revision and hardware-multiplier class. The rest of the target uses this file to turn -mmcu selections into concrete architectural properties, support-file paths, and diagnostics about unknown or inconsistent device data.
same_name_distinction: Implements the MSP430 device-data machinery declared in msp430-devices.h: it performs devices.csv path discovery from environment/toolchain locations, parses and validates MCU selections, and defines the built-in MCU lookup table and extracted_mcu_data storage. Unlike the header, this file is the executable implementation and data source rather than the shared interface declaration.
